run_multinode_training_job: run a multi-node training job on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
run_parse_args: run the argument parser to configure GPU count, node count, timeout, partition, and QoS for job submission
run_Trainer_call: run the Trainer callable to set up GPU arguments and start the training main loop
run_Trainer_checkpoint: run the Trainer checkpoint method to requeue a training job with a fresh init file
run_get_init_file: run get_init_file to create a unique UUID-named init file for distributed training synchronization
